content.short: Succinct enables reading Ethereum state securely across multiple supported chains.
content.description: Funded by Gnosis DAO and 0xPARC for R&D, Succinct is building the first permissionless, decentralized interoperability layer for Ethereum. Developers can apply proof-based cross-chain communication to future dApp projects, with safety as a default. Succinct uses zkSNARKs to accelerate and secure the validation of cross-chain messages and state transfers, enabling more trustworthy multi-chain applications across Ethereum and other supported networks. The project emphasizes open, verifiable proofs and censorship-resistant interoperability that remains accessible to developers of all levels.
content.meta: Succinct is an infrastructure platform for permissionless decentralized Ethereum interoperability. Discover Succinct and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
